equations.description: The forecast at completion must reconcile to actual cost plus remaining forecast.
equations.remediation: Reconcile the cost ledger and forecast detail; do not post the close until the identity holds.
equations.title: EAC equals actual cost plus ETC

equations.description: Variance at completion must agree with the approved budget and current EAC.
equations.remediation: Recalculate VAC from governed BAC and EAC.
equations.title: VAC equals BAC minus EAC

equations.description: Reported cost variance must reconcile to earned value and actual cost.
equations.remediation: Recalculate CV and investigate source-period or currency mismatches.
equations.title: Cost variance equals EV minus AC

equations.description: Reported schedule variance must reconcile to earned and planned value.
equations.remediation: Recalculate SV and verify the status date and baseline time-phasing.
equations.title: Schedule variance equals EV minus PV

equations.description: The cost performance index must be derived from the same EV and AC basis.
equations.remediation: Recalculate CPI; verify zero-value, currency and accounting-period handling.
equations.title: CPI equals EV divided by AC

equations.description: The schedule performance index must be derived from the same EV and PV basis.
equations.remediation: Recalculate SPI and verify baseline and status-period alignment.
equations.title: SPI equals EV divided by PV

equations.description: Current budget must be traceable to the baseline plus approved change.
equations.remediation: Locate unauthorized budget movement or missing approved change records.
equations.title: Current budget bridges baseline and approved change

equations.description: The supplied risk-adjusted summary must reconcile to deterministic EAC, pending change and the configured risk uplift. This control validates a declared bridge; it does not calculate a statistical P80.
equations.remediation: Reconcile the risk register and pending-change log to the submitted risk-adjusted summary.
equations.title: Risk-adjusted EAC bridges forecast, pending change and configured risk uplift

equations.description: An in-progress activity should retain positive remaining duration.
equations.remediation: Correct activity status, actual finish or remaining duration in P6.
equations.title: In-progress activity retains remaining duration

equations.description: The built-in -800 hour threshold is a conservative starter control for extreme negative float, not a contractual limit.
equations.remediation: Replace the starter threshold with a project-specific equation, then review constraints, calendars and driving relationships.
equations.title: Total float remains above the starter review threshold

equations.description: Forecasts beyond delegated authority require escalation before the close is certified.
equations.remediation: Escalate the account forecast or supply an approved authorization change.
equations.title: Control-account EAC remains within delegated authorization
